ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution with approximately 82% high-intensity white/light-gray pixels and 18% low-intensity black/dark-gray pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant high-intensity central region bounded by a continuous low-intensity perimeter band of varying thickness. The left lobe contains four discrete low-intensity circular clusters (blobs) at mid-depth. The right lobe contains three primary low-intensity circular clusters and several smaller, low-contrast speckles.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Calculated V-shaped depression with a central angle of approximately 72 degrees; notch depth occupies roughly 15% of the total visible vertical fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Extremely jagged profile with 15-18 distinct high-amplitude peaks across the total span. Left lobe features five primary serrations with secondary micro-fluctuations. Right lobe features six prominent, sharp triangular serrations with deep valleys.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Pronounced concave upward curve originating from the median notch, terminating in sharp, slightly recurved distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-intensity white pixel clusters (barnacle growth) visible on the superior edge of the left tip. Small, circular pockmarks (likely attachment scars) distributed randomly across both white lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three thin, parallel low-contrast gray linear marks oriented horizontally on the lower quadrant of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable reddish-brown and white epibiotic cluster (barnacles/cyamids) on the far right distal tip; series of distinct black focal pigmentation spots on the interior white surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly unique constellation of 7-8 large, circular black spots positioned mid-lobe, creating a distinctive pattern on the white ventral field.
